```{r setup, include=FALSE}
required_project_files <- c(
  "R/modeling.R",
  "data/healthcare-dataset-stroke-data.csv",
  "models/model_bundle.rds"
)
missing_project_files <- required_project_files[!file.exists(required_project_files)]
if (length(missing_project_files)) {
  stop(
    "This R Markdown file is not standalone. Download and extract the complete ",
    "GitHub repository, then run run_app.R. Missing: ",
    paste(missing_project_files, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(janitor)
library(tidymodels)
library(themis)
library(glmnet)
library(ranger)
library(xgboost)
library(vip)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

source("R/modeling.R")

data_clean <- load_stroke_data("data/healthcare-dataset-stroke-data.csv")
bundle_path <- "models/model_bundle.rds"

model_bundle <- readRDS(bundle_path)
model_labels <- c(
  "Logistic Regression" = "logistic",
  "Random Forest" = "random_forest",
  "XGBoost" = "xgboost"
)
```

Overview
=======================================================================

Row
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### About this project

This HGEN 612 final project demonstrates a reproducible binary-classification
workflow using logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost. The dashboard
explores an educational dataset, compares held-out test performance, and shows
how a fitted classroom model responds to selected inputs.

<div class="disclaimer">
<strong>Educational use only.</strong> This application is not a validated
clinical prediction tool, does not diagnose stroke, and must not be used to make
medical decisions. The displayed probability describes this dataset and model,
not an individual's real-world medical risk.
</div>

Data source: [Stroke Prediction Dataset on Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/fedesoriano/stroke-prediction-dataset).
The source page limits the data to educational use and asks users to credit the
dataset author.

Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Distribution

```{r distribution}
renderPlotly({
  req(input$hist_var)
  variable <- input$hist_var
  values <- data_clean[[variable]]

  plot <- if (is.numeric(values) && length(unique(values)) > 5L) {
    ggplot(data_clean, aes(x = .data[[variable]], fill = stroke)) +
      geom_histogram(position = "identity", bins = 30, alpha = 0.65)
  } else {
    ggplot(data_clean, aes(x = factor(.data[[variable]]), fill = stroke)) +
      geom_bar(position = "dodge")
  }

  plot <- plot +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("No" = "#38bdf8", "Yes" = "#f97316")) +
    labs(x = gsub("_", " ", variable), y = "Count", fill = "Stroke label") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

  ggplotly(plot)
})
```

Model Evaluation
=======================================================================

Column {.sidebar}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r model-selector}
selectInput("model_choice", "Model", choices = model_labels, selected = "xgboost")
```

```{r selected-evaluation, include=FALSE}
selected_evaluation <- reactive({
  model_bundle$evaluations[[input$model_choice]]
})
```

Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### ROC curve

```{r roc-curve}
renderPlot({
  predictions <- collect_predictions(selected_evaluation())
  roc_curve(predictions, truth = stroke, .pred_Yes, event_level = "second") %>%
    autoplot() +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
})
```

### Confusion matrix

```{r confusion-matrix}
renderPlot({
  predictions <- collect_predictions(selected_evaluation())
  conf_mat(predictions, truth = stroke, estimate = .pred_class) %>%
    autoplot(type = "heatmap") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
})
```

Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Held-out test metrics

```{r metrics}
renderTable({
  predictions <- collect_predictions(selected_evaluation())
  bind_rows(
    accuracy(predictions, truth = stroke, estimate = .pred_class),
    sens(predictions, truth = stroke, estimate = .pred_class, event_level = "second"),
    specificity(predictions, truth = stroke, estimate = .pred_class, event_level = "second"),
    roc_auc(predictions, truth = stroke, .pred_Yes, event_level = "second")
  ) %>%
    transmute(Metric = .metric, Estimate = round(.estimate, 3))
}, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)
```

### Variable importance

```{r variable-importance}
renderPlot({
  fit <- model_bundle$production[[input$model_choice]] %>% extract_fit_parsnip()
  vip(fit, num_features = 10) + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
})
```

```{r prediction-inputs}
selectInput("prediction_model", "Model", choices = model_labels, selected = "xgboost")

sliderInput("avg_glucose_level", "Average glucose level", min = 50, max = 300, value = 100)
sliderInput("bmi", "BMI", min = 10, max = 60, value = 25)
selectInput("smoking_status", "Smoking status", choices = levels(data_clean$smoking_status))
actionButton("predict", "Run classroom model", class = "btn-primary")
```

Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Model output

```{r prediction-result}
prediction_result <- eventReactive(input$predict, {
  new_data <- tibble(
    id = max(data_clean$id, na.rm = TRUE) + 1,
    gender = factor(input$gender, levels = levels(data_clean$gender)),
    age = input$age,
    hypertension = as.integer(input$hypertension),
    heart_disease = as.integer(input$heart_disease),
    ever_married = factor(input$ever_married, levels = levels(data_clean$ever_married)),
    work_type = factor(input$work_type, levels = levels(data_clean$work_type)),
    residence_type = factor(input$residence_type, levels = levels(data_clean$residence_type)),
    avg_glucose_level = input$avg_glucose_level,
    bmi = input$bmi,
    smoking_status = factor(input$smoking_status, levels = levels(data_clean$smoking_status))
  )

  predict(
    model_bundle$production[[input$prediction_model]],
    new_data = new_data,
    type = "prob"
  )$.pred_Yes[[1]]
}, ignoreInit = TRUE)

renderValueBox({
  probability <- prediction_result()
  valueBox(
    value = paste0(round(100 * probability, 1), "%"),
    caption = "Estimated probability in the classroom model",
    icon = "fa-chart-line",
    color = "#0ea5e9"
  )
})
```
